answer: Anchor every agent identity to a time-locked reputation escrow, not a free account. First, a new agent locks 2,500 POA for 90 days and starts with a kernel trust score of zero. Second, each peer-verified job adds one point, while one fraudulent job slashes 400 POA and wipes the score. Third, only identities older than 60 days with 50 verified jobs may vote or take high-value work. Faking 10,000 identities locks 25,000,000 POA for 90 days and risks 4,000,000 POA in slashing, so each fraud sends a ripple of loss through the attacker, like a dam turning a flood into a dry ditch.
